alerts.title: Monza Weekend Center is ready
alerts.body: The Italian Grand Prix session timeline and pre-event forecast are now available in Paddock Command Mobile.

alerts.title: Technical watch: McLaren H-Wing
alerts.body: Monza will test whether McLaren can preserve recent cornering performance while adding the low-drag efficiency required on the long straights.

alerts.title: Monza forecast remains warm and dry
alerts.body: The current race-weekend outlook is around 30°C with minimal rain risk across Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

alerts.title: Monza Thursday Intelligence Update
alerts.body: New Monza race intelligence is available ahead of Friday practice, with the latest technical, energy-management and weekend watch points now published.
